title: servers.server_boost_updated
description: ServerBoostUpdated is a full snapshot of a server's boosts, not a diff. A consumer applies it only if Version is higher than the one it has, so duplicated or out-of-order deliveries are harmless.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

level.description: 0 hasta 4 boosts, 1 desde 5, 2 desde 15 y 3 desde 30.
